about: Follow-up destinations the picker can put on a QR (fu=id[.YYYYMMDD[.HHMM]]). Optional per-trust layer: no file = no follow-up row in the picker. 'where', 'phone' and 'note' render on the patient page only when present; 'find_url' renders a 'How to find it' button linking the trust's OWN published directions page (open and check the page before adding — never model memory); 'checked' is when the where/find facts were last read on that page. 'info_slug' offers the matching trust leaflet as a one-tap add. Added Oscar 2026-09-03; wayfinding links same day. kind='pifu' (Oscar 2026-09-03, patient-initiated follow-up): NO booked appointment — the card tells the patient to call the unit if symptoms worsen or don't improve; 'pifu_text', 'phone', 'hours' and 'window_days' are VERBATIM facts from the trust's own PIFU leaflet ('source_url', read on 'checked'); picking a pifu destination puts that leaflet on the QR.
